# coefficients.json holds the thermodynamics for NB_GRAINS = 5 grains, generated by
# ../test1/generate_coefficients.py -ng 5 (Sum-based expressions, N-independent) with the
# parameters of test1. Generate the C++ coefficient classes at configure time.
execute_process(COMMAND python3 ${BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR}/GenerateCoefficient.py -r  -f  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/coefficients.json
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

set(CURRENT_EXE FissionGas2Dtest3)
add_executable(${CURRENT_EXE} main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(${CURRENT_EXE} Sloth)
set_compile_options(${CURRENT_EXE})
add_dependencies(tests ${CURRENT_EXE})

# The polycrystal mesh comes straight from Merope (merope.mesh.MeshGenerator2D + gmsh): see
# README.md in this directory and generate_mesh.sh. poly.msh has one physical group
# "grain_1..5" per crystallite, one "bubble_1..4" per bubble carved on the grain boundaries,
# and a periodic box. The bubbles are regions of the mesh itself: SLOTH only reads their
# attribute sets for the initial condition (no analytic bubble placement).
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/poly.msh ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/poly.msh COPYONLY)

# Short smoke run: 10 steps of dt=5 (AMR off, the estimator dominates the cost; use -amr for
# production runs). The specialized time files are appended to, not truncated, so a dirty
# Saves directory would corrupt the comparison.
add_test(
    NAME FissionGas2Dtest3
    COMMAND bash -c "rm -rf Saves && mpirun -np 2 $<TARGET_FILE:${CURRENT_EXE}> -noamr -t 50 -dtmin 5 -dtmax 5"
)
set_tests_properties(FissionGas2Dtest3 PROPERTIES LABELS "2D FISSIONGAS")

# Compare the bubble-phase inventory (columns 3-4, bit-reproducible) at tight tolerance, and
# the gas inventory + density of the MuGas problem at a looser one: the iterative solves are
# not bit-reproducible across runs (observed ~1e-4 relative in the energy/mu columns), and the
# mu columns are ~0 at early times where a relative criterion is meaningless.
create_col_comparison("CompareFissionGas2Dtest3" "op_time_specialized.csv"
    "Saves/Polycrystal/OrderParameters_time_specialized.csv" "3;4" relativeEpsilon 1e-8 FALSE
    "FissionGas2Dtest3" "2D FISSIONGAS")

create_col_comparison("CompareFissionGas2Dtest3Gas" "mug_time_specialized.csv"
    "Saves/Polycrystal/MuGas_time_specialized.csv" "3;5" relativeEpsilon 1e-2 FALSE
    "FissionGas2Dtest3" "2D FISSIONGAS")
